items.title: DRI seizes around 55,000 e-cigarettes worth more than Rs. 13.5 crore in two operations at Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port in Kolkata
items.summary: 28 OCT 2026 11:04AM by PIB Delhi The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) continues its sustained crackdown on illicit trade and seized over 55,000 smuggled e-cigarettes at Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata, on 24th October 2026. Acting on specific intelligence DRI officers intercepted two containers Nepal-bound transshipment consignment suspected to contain e-cigarettes.

facts.text: A detailed examination of the first container led to the recovery of 40,000 pieces of e-cigarettes of brand IGET in various flavours, hidden among the declared cargo.
In total around 55,000 e-cigarettes valued at Rs 13.50 crore were seized along with the cover cargo under relevant sections of Customs Act.

In the current FY 2026-27, DRI have already made seizure of around 3,00,000 e-cigarettes worth more than Rs. 120 crore in across various ports, airports, and ICDs in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi and West Bengal.

items.title: Green Hydrogen
items.summary: Hydrogen is an energy carrier that stores energy and delivers it for varied uses. In a fuel cell, it reacts with oxygen to produce electricity, leaving only water and heat as by-products, and no polluting compounds or greenhouse gases. Although pure hydrogen is not found in large quantities in nature, it can be extracted from compounds such as water or natural gas.

facts.text: India thus became one of the first few countries to define green hydrogen formally.
Road and rail transport: Fuel-cell vehicles convert hydrogen into electricity on board, which drives electric motors.
India’s first indigenous hydrogen-powered train was inaugurated on 17 July 2026 on the Jind–Sonipat section.
The 10-car trainset can carry around 2,600 passengers.
